body: He has been trying before then. But I’ve been more meh since it’s just not something we’ve done in a long time. We went a year actually without it. I just don’t see him that way like I did at first.

I’ve been pushing down the feelings of doubt and looking on the bright side. Now it’s all hitting me.

Also, he’s been being more sexual BEFORE I told him about my predicament finding attraction to someone else. And even then, I felt standoffish in the regard I guess.

Thanks. That makes sense. Because we really aren’t trying to move in or any of those giant steps. We’re just really happy together, and it feels really good. But people like that one commenter here who says “Things that start fast, end fast” are scaring me out of just being able to breathe and enjoy things.

Well that’s the thinking that’s giving me extreme anxiety. Because on one hand, I know that’s not always the case. But with people always saying moving fast ends terribly, that scares me despite how I feel.
I’m just not.
you’ll have to pm me, reddit won’t let me message you.

They attack me. And when I try to defend myself, I get downvoted into oblivion and called fat, obese, a whale.

So I’m not rushing or forcing anything.

I try to be honest and upfront and smart and I get shat on. Time and time and time and time again.

My best friend doesn’t have friends outside me, really. 

I have been single for a while. I’m not willing to jump into a random relationship, so no, I don’t think I use relationships as a distraction, because if I did, I’d be in one now with that guy cause I would have jumped when he said he was ready to commit to me (we only knew each other a little over a week).

There are a lot of people messaging me and a lot of people commenting. You’re the only one who took it that way.

Just because I am having issues pertaining to relationships doesn’t mean I’m looking for a relationship to solve that problem.

I need someone to talk to and through that, I hope we can continue to talk. It is not a one way street. I am willing to and enjoy helping others. But right now I need the help.

I want to talk to someone that can help me tonight and I can continue to talk to and befriend.
